# List View Settings Attribute

Changes how collections are displayed. This attribute can improve row readability and prevent users from changing the collection size or element order in the Inspector.

![img](../../../images/generated/img-attribute-list-view-settings.png)

[!code-csharp[](../../../../tests/Alchemy.Tests/Assets/Alchemy.Tests.EditorUI/Documentation/ListViewSettingsTest.cs#document)]

| Parameter | Description |
| - | - |
| ShowAddRemoveFooter | Whether to show the add/remove footer. |
| ShowAlternatingRowBackgrounds | Alternating row background style. |
| ShowBorder | Whether to show the list border. |
| ShowBoundCollectionSize | Whether to show the bound collection size field. |
| ShowFoldoutHeader | Whether to show the foldout header. |
| SelectionType | Selection type for list items. |
| Reorderable | Whether items can be reordered. |
| ReorderMode | Reorder mode for list items. |
